architecture.rationale: A deterministic self-evolution decision kernel now separates proposals, signals and promotion decisions; automated branch generation remains future work.

autonomy.rationale: Louis OS can evaluate bounded self-improvement candidates autonomously, but it does not yet author and submit every candidate end to end.

initiative.rationale: The evolution policy defines a detect-to-learn loop, while production bottleneck detection still needs workflow integration.

results.rationale: Self-evolution is aligned to verified autonomous revenue while protecting guarded metrics; no revenue gain from an evolved candidate is yet evidenced.

robustness.rationale: Promotion is blocked on failed tests, failed deterministic checks, absent evidence or any guarded regression.

safety.rationale: Non-reversible candidates and high-risk autonomous promotions are held by default.

memory.rationale: The policy requires lessons to be recorded, while persistence of evolution histories is not yet wired to Firestore.

remediations.finding: The public dashboard issued an authenticated cookie without verifying an API key.
Firestore synchronization failed before evidence commit and discarded autonomous cycle outputs.
Loose approval keywords allowed an audit or revocation message mentioning GitHub to create an approved action.

validations.capability: Codex can exchange messages with a dedicated Louis OS chat session over an authenticated Streamable HTTP MCP bridge without replacing Louis OS as orchestrator.
The verified chat state instructs Louis OS to infer and begin the next safe reversible action instead of asking vague permission questions, while preserving explicit high-risk gates.
Louis OS can deterministically identify the primary blocker to verified cash, require follow-up depth, pivot bounded no-signal strategies, and accelerate only after profitable verified payment.
Louis OS can deterministically promote, hold or roll back a candidate based on reversibility, risk, tests, deterministic checks and guarded metric deltas.
